summary: Verified fix for athlete Post-Training Log 'Pain Locations' bug. Body Region and Side (Laterality) are now tappable chips (no Radix Select). Full e2e flow works on mobile 390x780 and desktop 1920x1080 with athlete lucas.silva@email.com.
test_scenarios_verified: body-region-select container present; body-region-HipGroin/Knee/Neck/LowBack chips present
laterality-select is hidden until a body region is chosen (correct behavior)
Tap HipGroin then laterality-Right then click 'Add Pain Location' → toast 'Pain location added' appears; entry 'HipGroin — Right side • Level 5/10' rendered in list
Central region Neck auto-selects laterality N/A (chip has 'primary' class); hint 'Central region - typically N/A' visible; 'Add Pain Location' button enabled without tapping side
Multiple pains: 2 pains reported badge shows; each entry has X remove button; removing works (back to '1 pain reported')
End-to-end submit: session type chip (Strength) + pain_after slider bumped to 3 + one pain location added → clicking submit-btn shows 'Training session logged!' toast and redirects to /athlete
DESKTOP 1920x1080: Knee/Left add flow works; LowBack auto-N/A works; free-text session-type-input accepts custom 'Home training custom'; session-photo-add-btn renders
No console errors (only benign React DevTools info + a11y warning about DialogContent aria-describedby on install prompt modal - not related to this fix)
critical_code_review_comments: Minor a11y warning (pre-existing, unrelated): Radix DialogContent used by 'Install the app' popup is missing Description/aria-describedby. Not blocking but worth adding an aria-describedby or <DialogDescription> for accessibility.
Submit button label is 'Log Session' in code, not 'Log Training Session' as noted in review-request description. data-testid 'submit-btn' matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Created one real training session for lucas.silva during test (Strength, RPE 6, 60 min, HipGroin Right pain 5/10). This is expected real athlete data per task note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Athlete PostTrainingLog Body Region + Laterality now use tappable chips with data-testids body-region-<Region> and laterality-<Value>. Central regions (Neck, LowBack) auto-set laterality to N/A. Full flow verified end-to-end on mobile and desktop.
